name: arch-diagram
description: Draw readable architecture diagrams (system / stack / infra / cloud / service topology — 아키텍처 · 시스템 구성도 · 기술 스택 · 인프라 구성도) as self-contained HTML (light + dark), PNG, React/TSX, or an artifact: real brand logos (svgl, devicon, official AWS / Google Cloud / Azure icons, Lucide pictograms), labeled group boxes, orthogonal arrows that never cross text, a legend strip, and first-class Korean typography (embedded Pretendard, Hangul width budgets).

interface.shortDescription: Readable architecture diagrams with real logos and Korean typography.
